summary: Frontend-only regression + new-feature tests for simplified stock UX. LOGIN OK. /stok/input renders with all required data-testids; submitting form with product+gudang+tanggal_produksi+expired_date+jumlah shows success toast and a new row appears in stok-input-table with 'Tgl Produksi' populated. Also visible on /stok. Inline 'Produk Baru' dialog opens, saves (POST /api/master/barang_jadi returns {id,...}), toast success, dialog closes AND new product is present in options — HOWEVER the stok-produk Select does NOT auto-select the newly created product (remains 'Pilih produk...'), causing the follow-up 'Tambah Stok' to fail with 'Pilih produk dulu'. SALES regression (CRITICAL): creating an SO does not consume stock (as designed) — stock is consumed on KIRIM. After clicking sales-kirim + sales-kirim-confirm on SO-0005 (Kue Kering Premium qty=2), stock decreased 45 -> 43 (diff = 2). Toast 'Order dikirim · Invoice INV-0004'. FEFO consume still works after signature change to apply_delta/record_movement. Sidebar shows both 'GUDANG & STOK' (Input Stok, Stok Saat Ini, Riwayat Stok) and separate 'STOK LANJUTAN' (Penerimaan, Pengeluaran, Penyesuaian, Transfer Gudang, Stock Opname). Dashboard, Master Data, Produksi, Penjualan, Keuangan, HR, Laporan, Pengaturan, Audit pages all load without errors.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Produk Baru' save succeeds (dialog closes, toast shown, product IS created and returned with id, and appears in /api/master/barang_jadi/options), the stok-produk Select does NOT auto-select the new product — it still shows 'Pilih produk...'. Submitting immediately after triggers 'Pilih produk dulu' toast. Users must re-open the dropdown and pick the just-created product manually. RCA: In addMut.onSuccess, setForm({...,item_id:String(created.id)}) fires before ['options','barang_jadi'] refetch completes; Radix Select's value points to an id that has no matching SelectItem at that instant and later doesn't re-sync. Fix: await qc.invalidateQueries then setForm, or setQueryData with the created record before setForm, or push created to local products list.

issues: Radix DialogContent warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` — a11y warning only, non-blocking

action_items: Fix auto-select of newly created product on /stok/input after inline 'Produk Baru' save. Suggested fix inside addMut.onSuccess: (1) qc.setQueryData(['options','barang_jadi'], (prev) => [...(prev||[]), created]) THEN setForm({...,item_id:String(created.id)}), or (2) await qc.invalidateQueries + qc.refetchQueries before setForm. This is the only real defect; everything else works.
critical_code_review_comments: StokInputPage: onSuccess sets item_id before ensuring the options list contains the new item — causes Radix Select desync (main bug above).
sales_router.kirim consumes stock via consume_stock_fifo -> apply_delta unaffected by the added trailing tanggal_produksi param — regression confirmed OK.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (1 UX bug in new inline-add-product auto-select)

seed_data_creation: Created several test products (name pattern 'Tortilla QA Test *', 'QA Diagnostic *') and stock rows (Kue Kering Premium +7 and +25 previously), plus SO-0005 (Draft->Dikirim, INV-0004) and SO-0006 (Draft) via UI. Consider cleanup if noise.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simple stock input + sales regression already covered. When retesting, only re-verify inline 'Produk Baru' auto-selects the created product in stok-produk Select and that subsequent 'Tambah Stok' works without re-picking product. Sales KIRIM is the step that consumes stock, not SO create.
rca of the issue: Inline product add UX bug: setForm(item_id=new.id) is called synchronously in addMut.onSuccess while ['options','barang_jadi'] query is still refetching after invalidateQueries. Radix Select receives a value with no matching SelectItem, so it shows the placeholder. Even after the refetch resolves and a matching SelectItem exists, Radix Select does not re-derive its display from the persisted value in this scenario. Repro: /stok/input -> click 'Produk Baru' -> fill nama + satuan + harga -> Simpan Produk -> observe stok-produk still shows 'Pilih produk...'. Mitigation: pre-populate the react-query cache with the created entity via qc.setQueryData BEFORE setForm, or await refetch, then setForm.
